name: MonarchTeamCalendar
title: TeamCalendar
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn with LazyListScope.stickyHeader, androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll with one shared ScrollState, androidx.compose.material3.TooltipBox with PlainTooltip, MonarchAvatar, MonarchEmptyState, MonarchBanner, MonarchSkeleton, android.icu.text.DateFormat
summary: Who is away when: people down the start, the days of a month or a custom range across, absences as bars that span their days, half days as half bars, pending entries outlined, weekends and holidays shaded and today ringed.
whenToUse: For a team's leave or availability overview, where a manager scans who is out on which day and taps an absence to open it or an empty day to add one. Put a MonarchCalendarToolbar above it to move between months.
whenNotToUse: For one person's events day by day use MonarchAgendaList. For choosing a date use MonarchMiniMonth or the Material 3 DatePicker. For meetings with times use an event list or a time grid; this grid has whole and half days only.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable public fun MonarchTeamCalendar(members: List<MonarchTeamCalendarMember>, entries: List<MonarchTeamCalendarEntry>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, month: Long? = null, from: Long? = null, to: Long? = null, holidays: List<MonarchTeamCalendarHoliday> = emptyList(), weekendDays: Set<Int> = setOf(Calendar.SATURDAY, Calendar.SUNDAY), today: Long? = null, loading: Boolean = false, error: String? = null, showLegend: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchTeamCalendarLabels = MonarchTeamCalendarLabels(), onEntryClick: ((MonarchTeamCalendarEntry, MonarchTeamCalendarMember) -> Unit)? = null, onCellClick: ((MonarchTeamCalendarMember, Long) -> Unit)? = null, empty: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchTeamCalendarMember(id: String, name: String, image: Painter? = null, description: String? = null)

class MonarchTeamCalendarEntry(id: String, memberId: String, start: Long, end: Long? = null, label: String, color: Color = Color.Unspecified, portion: MonarchTeamCalendarPortion = MonarchTeamCalendarPortion.Full, portions: Map<Long, MonarchTeamCalendarPortion> = emptyMap(), pending: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchTeamCalendarPortion { Full, FirstHalf, SecondHalf }

class MonarchTeamCalendarLabels(person: String? = null, grid: ((String) -> String)? = null, today: String? = null, holiday: ((String) -> String)? = null, range: ((String, String) -> String)? = null, firstHalf: String? = null, secondHalf: String? = null, pending: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyDescription: String? = null, legend: String? = null, loading: String? = null)

options.name: members
options.description: The rows in display order, each with an id, a name, an optional photo Painter and an optional second line.

options.name: entries
options.description: The absences, each with a member id, a first and last day, a label, a color, a portion, per-day portions and pending. Days outside the range are left out.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the calendar. Give it a bounded height, as for any LazyColumn.

options.name: month
options.description: Any day of the month shown, as epoch milliseconds read in UTC. null is the month of today. Ignored when from and to are both set.

options.name: from
options.description: The first day of a custom range, used with to.

options.name: to
options.description: The last day of a custom range, inclusive. A day before from gives one day; at most 366 days are shown.

options.name: holidays
options.description: Non-working days for everyone: shaded, named in what TalkBack reads and in a tooltip on a long press of the day.

options.name: weekendDays
options.description: The shaded days of the week, Calendar.SUNDAY to Calendar.SATURDAY.

options.name: today
options.description: Today's date, ringed in the header and where the days start scrolled to. null is today on the device; pass a fixed value in tests and previews.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows a skeleton placeholder, named "Loading team calendar", instead of the grid.

options.name: error
options.description: Shows this message in a danger MonarchBanner, announced politely, instead of the grid.

options.name: showLegend
options.description: Shows the line under the grid that explains shading, half bars and faded bars.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Person", the grid name, "Today", the holiday and range phrases, "first half", "second half", "pending", the empty state, the legend and the loading name.

options.name: onEntryClick
options.description: Called when a bar is tapped. Without it bars are read but are not buttons.

options.name: onCellClick
options.description: Called with the member and the day's UTC midnight when an empty day is tapped, for example to add time away. Without it empty days take no taps and are not TalkBack elements.

options.name: empty
options.description: Replaces the built-in empty state shown when there are no members.

states.name: bars
states.description: Consecutive full days of one entry are one bar with the label inside, a solid start stripe in the entry color and a light tint of it; a bar cut by the range has no rounded edge on that side.

states.name: half day
states.description: A half bar at the start (first half) or the end (second half) of the day, without a label; the whole day is still the target.

states.name: pending
states.description: An outlined bar with no fill, and "pending" in what TalkBack reads.

states.name: weekend and holiday
states.description: The day's column is shaded in the muted fill; a holiday's name is read with its day and shown in a tooltip on a long press.

states.name: today
states.description: The day number is bold in the strong accent inside an accent ring, "Today" is read with it, and the days start scrolled to the day before today.

states.name: loading
states.description: A skeleton block instead of the grid.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger banner with the message instead of the grid.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState "Nobody to show" or the app's empty content when there are no members.

appearance: The grid sits on the surface color inside a default border with large corners; rows are separated by subtle dividers and the header by a default one. Weekend and holiday columns use the muted fill. Bars mix the entry color (the accent by default) into the surface color with a solid stripe at the start; labels keep the default text color, and day names the muted text color. High contrast themes use their stronger text, border and accent roles.
platformNotes: The web TeamCalendar is a table whose cells are squares per day, with the label in a hover title, and a roving tab stop moved with arrow, Home, End and Page keys. On a phone the people column stays fixed while the days scroll sideways in one shared scroll for every row, the day header stays pinned while rows scroll, and the grid opens at the day before today. Consecutive days of an entry are one spanning bar with its label inside, one TalkBack element and one target, so onEntryClick passes the entry and member but not the day (the web passes the day too). The label of a short bar and a holiday's name appear in a Material 3 tooltip on a long press instead of on hover. Pending entries are outlined instead of faded, because Monarch does not dim colors with alpha. Hardware keyboards move focus between the bars and the tappable empty days with Compose's own focus search, not the web's key map. Days are epoch milliseconds in UTC, as in DatePickerState; weekendDays use java.util.Calendar constants, and the locale comes from the configuration. error is a String, not a node. The web's accent color is used through the accent roles directly, because MonarchTone has no accent tone. Marked experimental as a domain composite until a Rook app adopts it. iOS has not built it yet; the planned iOS name is the same.
accessibility: The corner is a heading named for the grid, "Team calendar, November 2026" (or "Team calendar, Nov 2 – Nov 8, 2026" for a custom range).
Each person is one heading element, "Alex Kim, Design", so TalkBack's heading navigation moves from person to person.
Each day header is read as its full date, with "Today" before today's and "Holiday: name" after a holiday's.

Each bar is one element read as "Annual leave, Alex Kim, Monday, November 2 to Thursday, November 5", with "first half" or "second half" for a half day and "pending" for a pending entry; with onEntryClick it is a button.
With onCellClick each empty day is a button read as "Sam Lee, Wednesday, November 4"; without it empty days are not elements.
Days are 48dp wide and rows at least 48dp tall, so bars, half-day bars and empty days have 48dp targets reserved in the layout.
Half days, pending entries, today and holidays are said in words and drawn with shape (half bar, outline, ring), not only with color.
Names and descriptions wrap at the largest font size and the row grows to fit.
The error banner is a polite live region; the loading placeholder is named "Loading team calendar".
Right to left, the people column is at the right and earlier days are further right.
edgeCases: Give the calendar a bounded height; inside a vertically scrolling Column it needs Modifier.height.
One entry per person per day: when two entries cover the same day, the later one in entries is shown, as on the web.
An end before the start is treated as the start; an entry for an unknown member id is ignored.
A one-day or half-day bar has no visible label; it is read by TalkBack and shown in the tooltip.
Very long labels are cut with an ellipsis inside their bar; the full label is read and shown in the tooltip.
A custom range is capped at 366 days.
today defaults to the device's date at composition; pass a fixed value for previews and tests.
Bar colors are the app's: the fill is a tint of the color and the label keeps the default text color, so any color stays readable.

examples.title: Month with a toolbar
examples.template:
CompositionLocalProvider(LocalConfiguration provides locale) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
        MonarchCalendarToolbar(
            title = {{title}},
            view = MonarchCalendarToolbarView.Month,
            onToday = {},
            onPrevious = {},
            onNext = {},
            previousIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronLeft, contentDescription = null) },
            nextIcon = { Icon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
            views = listOf(MonarchCalendarToolbarView.Month),
            labels = MonarchCalendarToolbarLabels(today = {{todayLabel}}),
        )
        @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
        MonarchTeamCalendar(
            members = listOf(
            MonarchTeamCalendarMember(id = {{members.0.id}}, name = {{members.0.name}}, description = {{members.0.description}}),
            MonarchTeamCalendarMember(id = {{members.1.id}}, name = {{members.1.name}}, description = {{members.1.description}}),
            MonarchTeamCalendarMember(id = {{members.2.id}}, name = {{members.2.name}}, description = {{members.2.description}}),
            MonarchTeamCalendarMember(id = {{members.3.id}}, name = {{members.3.name}}, description = {{members.3.description}}),
            ),
            entries = listOf(
            MonarchTeamCalendarEntry(id = "1", memberId = {{entries.0.memberId}}, start = {{entries.0.start|millis}}, end = {{entries.0.end|millis}}, label = {{entries.0.label}}, color = hex({{entries.0.color}})),
            MonarchTeamCalendarEntry(id = "2", memberId = {{entries.1.memberId}}, start = {{entries.1.start|millis}}, label = {{entries.1.label}}, color = hex({{entries.1.color}}), portion = MonarchTeamCalendarPortion.{{entries.1.portion|pascal}}),
            MonarchTeamCalendarEntry(id = "3", memberId = {{entries.2.memberId}}, start = {{entries.2.start|millis}}, end = {{entries.2.end|millis}}, label = {{entries.2.label}}, color = hex({{entries.2.color}}), pending = {{entries.2.pending}}),
            MonarchTeamCalendarEntry(id = "4", memberId = {{entries.3.memberId}}, start = {{entries.3.start|millis}}, end = {{entries.3.end|millis}}, label = {{entries.3.label}}),
            ),
            month = {{month|millis}},
            holidays = listOf(MonarchTeamCalendarHoliday(date = {{holidays.0.date|millis}}, name = {{holidays.0.name}})),
            today = {{today|millis}},
        )
    }
}
